name: Highland Arabica
description: A smooth medium roast coffee with notes of cocoa and toasted almond. Freshly roasted beans bring a balanced aroma to your morning cup.

name: Coastal Blend
description: Bright and lively with citrus notes and a gentle finish. This carefully blended coffee makes an inviting cup for slow mornings.

name: Midnight Espresso
description: Bold espresso beans deliver a rich crema, dark chocolate flavor, and a full-bodied finish. Ideal for espresso and moka pot brewing.

name: Golden Decaf
description: Enjoy a mellow, comforting cup with caramel sweetness and a soft finish. Decaffeinated beans preserve the flavor for any time of day.

name: Mountain Peaberry
description: Distinctive peaberry beans offer a fragrant cup with berry-like brightness and a clean finish. A thoughtful choice for coffee enthusiasts.

name: Morning House Roast
description: A dependable everyday roast with warm nutty notes and balanced body. It pairs easily with breakfast and your favorite brewing routine.

name: Velvet Mocha Blend
description: Rich coffee flavor meets smooth cocoa tones in this comforting blend. Its rounded taste is delicious with milk or served black.

name: Estate Dark Roast
description: Deep roasted beans create smoky aromas and a lingering finish. Brew a strong, satisfying cup for an afternoon break.

name: Floral Light Roast
description: A light roast with delicate floral fragrance and gentle fruit notes. Its crisp character shines with pour-over brewing.

name: Weekend Blend
description: A balanced blend with hints of brown sugar and spice. Smooth, easy-drinking flavor makes it a welcome part of relaxed weekends.

name: Rainforest Reserve
description: Carefully selected beans create a silky body and subtle sweetness. The aroma opens with roasted nuts and finishes pleasantly clean.

name: Spiced Winter Roast
description: A cozy roast with cinnamon-like warmth, rich aroma, and a rounded finish. Enjoy it freshly brewed on cool evenings.

name: Classic Filter Coffee
description: A traditional, full-flavored roast designed for filter brewing. It delivers comforting strength, fragrant aroma, and a smooth finish.

name: Cocoa Trail Beans
description: Chocolate-forward coffee with a soft nutty character and low-key acidity. A versatile roast for espresso, filter, or French press.

name: Sunrise Single Origin
description: Bright single-origin beans reveal gentle fruit tones and a clean, refreshing finish. Freshly ground coffee brings the aroma to life.
